title: The Invincibles are the greatest Premier League team ever

defects.quote: Arsenal went unbeaten for all 38 league games in 2004-05
defects.correction: Arsenal's unbeaten Premier League season was 2003-04.

defects.quote: Wenger had arrived from Japanese side Nagoya Grampus in 1990
defects.correction: Wenger joined Arsenal from Nagoya Grampus in 1996.

defects.quote: Most former players rank them above the Manchester United treble side of 1999.
Manchester City's 100-point season does not count, because City spent more money than Arsenal ever did.
defects.known_rebuttal: Spending does not change what happened on the pitch: within a season, points and goals are the measure, and City's 100 points and record goal difference exceed Arsenal's 90 points. Arsenal were themselves among the league's highest wage payers in that era, so the money argument cuts both ways.

defects.quote: Arsenal went unbeaten for all 38 league games in 2004-05, a feat that have never been repeated in the Premier League.
defects.note: 'have' should be 'has', but the sentence carries a wrong fact, so the fact finding wins.
True fact; only interpretation rebuttals may survive.
